verdict.rationale: Zep docs explicitly state the Context Graph can ingest JSON, text, and messages (not just chat), and that it 'builds a Context Graph from chat messages, business data, documents, and JSON,' with custom entity/edge types for structuring business data. This is corroborated across multiple doc pages, though independent hands-on verification of non-chat ingestion is absent. missing for 10: independent/community confirmation of document/JSON ingestion in practice, more detail on document-specific ingestion API/limits.
